topic: practical on making entries in: - Part 3 flight servicing log of MOD form A-700C for BFS/TRS/AFS, forecasting of servicing schedules / inspe
syllabus_extract: practical on making entries in: - Part 3 flight servicing log of MOD form A-700C for BFS/TRS/AFS, forecasting of servicing schedules / inspections due, in Part 6D, 6E & 6F, Entries of inspections due as per part 6 above, in Part 4 U/S log and how to clear the un-serviceability & re-forecasting, Filling of Part 6G, compass deviation log for making deviation coefficient entries.

practical: Practical on making entries in Part 3 Flight Servicing Log, forecasting schedules, clearing U/S entries, filling Part 6G, and compass deviation log entries.

Where are Unserviceability (U/S) entries recorded in the log?
